accreditationPage.title: What GSA accreditation means
accreditationPage.intro: Every school in our directory is reviewed by the GSA team before it appears. But accreditation is a different standard — the gold standard for school integrations and immersions worldwide.
accreditationPage.listedBody: A member of the GSA network that has registered to host and passed a basic review: the school is real, the contact is genuine, and the listing is accurate. Visits to listed hosts are facilitated by the GSA team.
accreditationPage.accreditedBody: A school that has completed GSA's full verification — personally, by a human, never automatically. Accredited schools are actively promoted by GSA, deliver structured immersion programmes, and issue a verification statement your leadership team can use for trip approval.
